title: One Cable Left
hook: An urgent warning about an opening airlock immediately creates high-stakes spatial danger.
cliffhanger: The captain orders the single cable given to his daughter, raising the personal stakes before the outcome is revealed.
cliffhanger_quote: Give the cable to my daughter first.
why_it_works: The escalating dilemma from a failing airlock to a single rescue cable creates immediate, life-or-death tension that holds attention.

title: Sold Out Into Space
hook: An alarmed radio operator drops the devastating news that their space station has just been sold, instantly establishing high stakes for the trapped crew.
cliffhanger: The transmission cuts abruptly to static right after the realization that no rescue ship is coming for the thirty people aboard.
why_it_works: It starts immediately with a shocking betrayal and escalates tension through a ticking clock until the chilling cut to static.
